svg.title: Case 3: Growth and eroding trust
svg.desc: Rapid growth overwhelmed a giant-server monolith, with fortnightly outages and manual Excel reporting. I helped plan focused business services and build a separate data platform for reliable operations and accurate real-time decisions.
svg.text: They could absorb the outages. Customer trust was harder
Revenue doubled each year, but the system crashed roughly every two weeks.
Operations absorbed the disruption; reporting relied on manual extracts and Excel.
A GROWING BUSINESS WITH ITS FOUNDATIONS BEING ERODED
More dependable operations. Live business insight.
Contain disruption, improve service, and support informed decisions as the business grows.
The containers and waves illustrate eroding reliability and trust; they do not depict an actual business collapse.
